# `aitbc messaging dm read`

Fetch and decrypt one DM addressed to this wallet.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc messaging dm read [OPTIONS] TX_HASH
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tx_hash` | text | yes | — |

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet whose DM key decrypts the message |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc messaging dm read --wallet <wallet_name> TX_HASH
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc messaging dm read --wallet <wallet_name> TX_HASH --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
